text: The layout review removes invalid position:inline-block and the author confirms that it was unintended. The assigned CSS applies logical margin-block shorthand, moves the light background from the overall grid to each fieldset, and adds 32px icon dimensions after a request to keep icons from growing with font size. Current source uses logical icon dimensions and tokens. These are scoped sync-form corrections. The 12–22px font-size sequence is a manual test instruction, and the summary explicitly leaves list-size growth unfixed. Existing source lessons cover the flex/DOM structure and naming. Partial historical evidence: Bug 1944982comment1 unavailable; no new runtime validation.
title: Keep the accepted sync-layout corrections separate from unfinished list resizing
